r198931298.text:
i saw this on the dev's yt and gave it a go

PROS
pretty good torbjorn simulator td game i rate it higher than pve in overwatch
3d is a nice change from usual bird eye view td format
the pop gun and hammer feels smooth
cute lil gobbos come to take ur forge

CONS
needs option to turn off the recoil head bob effect
at the time of playing hp meter was bugged
i think if the pop gun had a close quarters secondary mode that would be nice
switching to the hammer is too slow
r198931298.devResponse:
Thanks for the review! I've updated the game based on your feedback:

Head-bob: Reduced by 50%.
Swap Speed: 33% faster.
Hammer: New icon instead of heart and clearer melee/AoE functionality.
Thanks for helping me improve the game!

triage.summary: Player enjoyed the game as a tower defense experience with good 3D visuals and controls, but wants recoil head bob toggle, reports a health meter bug, and suggests quality-of-life improvements.

points.text: 3D tower defense format is a nice change from usual top-down view.
Pop gun and hammer controls feel smooth.
Recoil head bob effect needs a toggle option to turn it off.
Health meter was bugged at time of playing.
Pop gun should have a close quarters secondary mode.
Hammer switching speed is too slow.

releases.name: Reforge Front Update
releases.notes:
New Features

- 
Controller Support: Full support added with aim assist.

- 
macOS: Now officially playable on Mac.

- 
Widescreen: UI and textures now scale correctly.

- 
Blood Moon: New event! Snow and lava levels are now night-only.

Gameplay & Audio

- 
Speed: Switching equipment is now 33% faster.

- 
Comfort: Reduced headbob by 50%.

- 
Waves: Press Q to start waves manually.

- 
Audio: Balanced volume and added new button SFX.

Fixes & Improvements

- 
Bombs: Now properly damage enemies (not just you!).

- 
Menus: Fixed mouse disappearing/getting stuck.

- 
Visuals: Refined lighting and color grading.

updated pricing using Steam’s new Purchasing Power conversion to ensure the game is accessible to more players. Prices reduced by 20% or more in many regions.Example: Our EU price has been lowered from €4,99 to €3,55.

Thanks for playing!

releases.name: Update 1.01
releases.notes:
- 
Now in 28 languages, including Japanese, Korean and Chinese. The game follows your Steam language, or pick one in Options

- 
Now playable on Linux

- 
New lighting in every world: an overcast forest, freezing snow, warm lava, a torchlit hub and a glowing furnace

- 
New title logo, with its own version in Japanese, Korean and Chinese

- 
The whole Options menu now works with a controller: LB/RB switch tabs and B goes back, great on Steam Deck

- 
Controller: hold LT to aim, which is when aim assist kicks in. Sprint is now on L3, crouch on R3 and bomb on View

- 
Five achievements that could not be unlocked before now unlock

- 
Smoother play: no freeze on the first hit, and much steadier frame rates on Mac

- 
Coin, heart and bomb icons now look the same on every system

- 
New 16:10 resolutions, including Steam Deck's 1280x800

- 
Fixed: the 2560x1440 option set 2560x1080, rebinding a key removed its controller button, and the pause menu was empty after pressing Esc in Options

- 
Fixed: the lava world's last wave played the wrong music, and the snow music restarted off the beat
